features.title: A sturdy frame for family moments
features.text: Made with a combination of solid pinewood and plywood, the Dompy sofa is built to withstand daily use while offering a comfortable place for everyone to gather.

features.title: Springs for added bounce and comfort
features.text: The zigzag springs in the seat structure provide responsive support and a slight bounce, ensuring comfort across all seating areas.

features.title: Armrests designed for complete comfort
features.text: Soft and wide armrests cradle your arms gently, giving you the ergonomic support you need for long sitting or lounging sessions.

features.title: Elegant tufted design in cushions
features.text: Features a tufted designed in cushions for added elegance and refined aesthetics that adapts to any living space.

features.title: Cylindrical legs for a modern touch
features.text: Sturdy cylindrical legs with a wood-like finish ensure stability and add a sleek, modern element to the sofa’s design.
